notes.title: How to change the Language
notes.content:
Dear users,

Some of you have German  as the default language when installing Home Architect - Design your floor plans in 3D. You can change the language! Here are the steps:

[u]To change the language:[/u]
1. click on the Arrow at the top left corner
2. click on [b]Einstellungen[/b] (=Settings)
3. click on [b]Sprache[/b] (=Language)
4. choose among the list of languages and countries to use Home Architect
5. [b]Restart[/b] Home Architect to apply the new language

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31016462/88cc8299361cf2c9fa9ddd04e9882c98a4681c4d.png[/img]

If you experience this bug, it would [b]help us[/b] if you could
- find your [b]App.log[/b] file located here: [b]C:\USERS\Your_Username\Documents\Home Architect…\[/b]
- send it to us at support@anuman.com

Many thanks!
